loops.note: Collisions re-resolved by QUALIFYING the shared sense on both sides — 听见 "to hear (and catch it)" / 听到 "to hear (as a result)" — so the collision stays visible to every guard while the buttons read differently. A sixth build gate now fails if a card’s own dictionary meaning does not survive its rewrite. And the thing both reference apps do that this one did not: 1,270 example sentences, HSK 1 and 2 at 100%, every character build-gated to be at or below the card’s own level.

The "or" splitter landed and the 38 grade-a-right-answer-wrong collisions went to zero — but the critic caught the cure being worse than the disease. They had been fixed by moving BOTH cards off the shared word, which hides the collision from the gate, from the distractor guard, and from the app’s own search: 听见 shipped "to catch a sound" and /browse?q=hear could no longer find it.

loops.note: Vocabulary rebuilt: 4,316 of 4,316 official entries traceable, all four slang senses gone, 3,475 glosses hand-authored against the official part of speech. Tone colour moved from a render-time guess to build-time data — every one of 7,907 syllables painted, where loop 1 coloured only the 29% of words that were monosyllabic.
